Name: Skylark Castle Farm
Author: hoshikuzunosora
Description:
Hi I got hit by a massive beam of inspiration after getting [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0xGPi-Al3zQ]Fleetwood Mac's Rhiannon[/url] stuck in my head so. I made this!

Besides, I've always wanted to have a farm surrounded by moats to have a sort of princess-y vibe with some runs.

Yes I did this in two days while patching bugs to my first one (bugs that I've ENSURED didn't cross over to this one)

yes I am insane and have way too much time on my hands

ANYWAY-

Features!

-A completely custom farm type with custom starter gift, house decoration, and farm icon

-A working quarry that spawns ore just like on the mountain farm

-A dedicated spot for ranching with blue grass and invisible barriers to prevent animals from escaping

-LOTS of room to both build and farm, with three spots dedicated to junimo huts and a space that can fit at LEAST 12 sheds comfortably!

[color=#e69138][b][size=4]Requirements:[/size][/b]

[/color][size=2]Content Patcher[/size][size=3]
[/size]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets

I've tested this mod thoroughly for bugs (i swear it this time) but if you run into an issue, please don't hesitate to tell me! If ya have a suggestion or feedback, also be sure to tell me!

Thank you for looking at my mod. I hope you have a nice day/night
